use_case: Skin-image analysis device software function: flags possible pressure injuries (stage 1 and deep tissue) in photos of at-risk skin taken by nurses, for follow-up assessment
vendor_or_model: In-house image classification model fine-tuned from an open-source pretrained vision model; runs as a service in the device cloud
data_categories: Training: de-identified skin images from partner hospitals with skin tone annotations. Production: patient photos, body site, and patient identifiers (PHI in the device cloud); outputs are flags, heat maps, and confidence scores (PHI)
consequential_decision_category: Health care; Safety/CI (device function affecting patient care)
human_in_the_loop: A nurse reviews every flag and performs the standard skin assessment; the tool never documents or escalates on its own; a negative result does not rule out injury
applicable_laws: FD&C Act and 21 CFR Part 820 design controls; FD&C Act 524B (cyber device; N31-33-R05); FDA draft guidance on AI-enabled device software functions (January 2025, nonbinding); FDA PCCP guidance for AI-enabled device software functions (December 2024); HIPAA Security Rule for production images in the device cloud (N62-R01); 45 CFR 92.210 duties of hospital customers; FTC Act Section 5 (performance claims)
status: In development; marketing submission planned 2027 Q3

use_case: Enterprise generative AI coding assistant for device firmware and device cloud code
vendor_or_model: Enterprise coding assistant (vendor SaaS) under a contract with no training on company data
data_categories: Source code and design comments (Confidential); no PHI
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review, test, and merge every suggestion through normal code review; AI output is never merged without a second reviewer
applicable_laws: FD&C Act 524B(b)(2) and 21 CFR 820.10(c) (secure development of device software); trade secret protection; open-source license obligations
status: Proposed; pilot with 10 engineers approved to start 2026-11-01

use_case: Public generative AI assistants used by engineers without approval
vendor_or_model: Various public chatbots and coding assistants (personal accounts)
data_categories: Source code pasted by engineers (Confidential); risk of vulnerability details or PHI
risk_tier: High (if PHI, unfixed vulnerabilities, or signing material entered)
applicable_laws: HIPAA if PHI is entered (no BAA); trade secret protection
status: Prohibited (POL-05 4.8); blocked on company laptops from 2026-11-30
